evidence: A late edit injected after real exclusive disk save was closed instead of returning saved_but_open.
WM_CHAR inserted ! after dirty-clear and before WM_CLOSE; actual observed editor text was !Testo completo.

coverage: Real ManagedDocuments and document worker using ClassicNotepadBridge and native hidden Windows Edit control.
Late edits during disk save; interactive typing between dirty-clear and close.
Failed readonly request, timeout after application, failed read, failed PostMessage and close timeout.
Original readonly style and changed-title cleanup; explicit discard; wrong identity and no authorization.
Save-only followed by immutable new-version save, preserving both copies and later unsaved editor text; close_clean snapshot comparison.
substitutions: Test-owned hidden parent of class Notepad uses DefWindowProc: no installed Notepad process or native save dialog.
Delivery/clock/Win32 failures injected at native boundaries; disk files and Edit/message dispatch real.
No accounts, models, microphones or user profile files involved.

independent_review.scope: read-only working tree against base; targeted recheck after changed-title test and documentation update

limits: Installed classic Notepad on Windows10 and target i3-2100/HDD hardware require manual verification.
EM_SETREADONLY blocks interactive editor changes, not arbitrary programmatic writes by unrelated automation.
Restoration is attempted on verified owned live controls; a hung process may fail Win32 messages.
No functional Linux tests, new package, build, merge, release or user-data/configuration changes.
